blocks.html: MOTHER’S DAY BEAUTY FAIR at ROBINSONS MALLS

Treat mom to a day of glam and wellness activities at Robinsons Malls’ Beauty Fair on May 10, Sunday, Mother’s Day.
Shop at Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Metro East, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga and Robinsons Place Lipa from May 4 to 10 and for a minimum of Php500.00 single receipt purchase, register mom for one day of pampering, make-over sessions and fun games made especially for moms and kids!

From May 4 to 9, visit Robinsons Galleria’s exhibit booths featuring merchandise for different moms. There will also be games and raffle prizes to be given away.
On May 10, moms head to the activity area of Robinsons Galleria and join the free Zumba lessons or enjoy a day of free hand paraffin, spot massage, nail art and a lot more activities!
At Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas and Robinsons Sta. Rosa, moms will be given make-over services on May 11 plus a chance to win raffle prizes!
For more information, you may call (02) 397-1888, log in at www.robinsonsmalls.com or check Robinsons Malls Facebook page at www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls
